LanguageData.CC_Settings_RestByNeed: Bed rest only when it makes sense
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RestByNeed_Tip: The game sends anyone to bed rest who has a tended wound still healing, however small, or an illness still building immunity, however mild, and keeps them there until it has passed: a tended scratch or a head cold can mean days in bed. With this on, only what needs bed sends them there. A serious wound while it heals (heavy bleeding, a vital part or an organ, a deep wound), or wounds that together bring strong pain or leave them lame or clumsy. An illness that can kill, until they are immune. A stage of any illness that brings strong pain or leaves consciousness, moving or breathing poor. Some of Rimfolk's serious illnesses from the stage they are really underway. And what the game makes urgent: down, an operation due, labor, bleeding. With anything else they keep working, and its pain, weakness and mood go on costing them; a cold, a fever's first days or a sprain has them sleep a little more at night, never all day. Small things to tend, such as a sunburn or a bruise, still bring them to bed to be tended and up again after, but while no doctor is free they keep working rather than wait in bed. Your own order to a medical bed ("rest until healed") and the council's rest when ill decree keep the game's rest. Each condition's tooltip on the health tab says whether it keeps them working or sends them to bed, and why. With Smart Medicine, a condition you take off bed rest in its menu stays off. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RestByNeed: Only what needs bed sends someone there: the flu or a deep wound does, a sunburn, a cold or a tended scratch doesn't.
